title: Covariance model review knowledge
scope: Evidence and package boundaries for deterministic covariance candidates and diagnostics.
guidance: Require stable symbol order, matrix identity, diagnostics, and candidate eligibility before downstream use.
Preserve failed or ineligible candidates without repair or silent substitution.
Use the owner specification for estimators, matrix units, tolerances, and downstream eligibility.
assumptions: The deterministic Quant port owns numerical matrix computation and validation.
warnings: A package-reported success state does not replace independent project diagnostics.
